title: Getting a Turkish Tax Number as a Foreigner (Vergi Kimlik Numarası)
excerpt: Why you need a Turkish tax number, how to get one online in a few minutes with your passport, and when your residence permit number takes its place.
bodyHtml:
A Turkish tax number (vergi kimlik numarası) is one of the first things you'll be asked for in Türkiye. It is not only for paying tax — it is how offices, banks and insurers identify you. For a foreigner without a residence permit, it is usually the first step.

This guide is practical information, not tax advice.

What you need it for

  • Opening a bank account — banks ask for it alongside your passport.

  • Your residence permit application — you need it to pay the permit fees and to buy the Turkish health insurance most first-time applicants need.

  • Buying property or a vehicle, and many contracts.

Get it early: several of the other steps in the Handbook assume you already have it.

How to get it: online, in a few minutes

Foreigners get a "potential tax identification number" online through the Revenue Administration (GİB), without going to a tax office. You need your passport and an address in Türkiye.

  1. Go to GİB's Interactive Tax Office or Digital Tax Office and choose Potential Tax Identification Number for Foreigners (Yabancılar İçin Potansiyel Vergi Kimlik Numarası). The form is available in English.

  2. Enter your details exactly as they appear in your passport: your name, your parents' names, your date and place of birth and your passport number, plus a mobile number and your address in Türkiye.

  3. Upload a photo of your passport's photo page (1 MB at most).

  4. Submit. Your 10-digit tax number appears on screen straight away, and you can download the document as a PDF. Save it — you'll be asked for it again.

If the online application is rejected even though your details are correct, go to a tax office (vergi dairesi) with your passport: tax offices now handle only those cases.

You don't need an agent or a paid service for this — the official site is all there is to it. Use only the gib.gov.tr sites, never a lookalike.

Once you have a residence permit

A residence permit card carries a foreign identity number starting with 99 (yabancı kimlik numarası). Türkiye's Revenue Administration uses that foreign identity number as your tax number too, so once you have the card, it is the number to give.

Keep it safe

Your tax number is tied to your identity and used across official records. Share it with banks, insurers, landlords' agents and officials who need it — not with anyone who contacts you unprompted asking for it.
